recordedProductIssues: Dim scrim and black masks make the demo screen murky and low-contrast beside the bright hook text
White cut-out around the highlighted button is a hard rectangle

defects.problem: Large dead band between the screen card and the caption line, and the caption plus small footnote sit low and tiny; the frame feels top-heavy with the bottom third empty
defects.fix: Move caption closer to the card or enlarge the footnote, keeping position fixed across the section

defects.problem: 'There.' detail inset has a ragged black top edge and the crop of the highlight looks cramped inside its box
defects.fix: Reframe the inset crop so the ring has even padding and no stray edge

defects.problem: Left screen is dimmed so field labels are barely readable while the 65 percent stat carries the beat; the screen is dead weight
defects.fix: Hold the dim consistently from the 'There.' beat and keep the stat as the single focal point

couldNotAssess: Motion, easing and dissolve quality between sampled frames
oneLineVerdict: Stable and clean, honest labelling, but the layout is a templated card-plus-text with an empty lower band and a murky dimmed screen.
